questions: How many UTe2 crystals did you measure with the pulse protocol, and how many showed the memory effect? In particular, does S3 (RRR 395), which appears only in the ac data of Fig. 4h, show it?
Why were the others set aside, if any were?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example rotation toward the a axis, pulse maps of S1 away from 20 T, excitations above 20 A cm^-2, and the waiting times behind "persists over a timescale of at least several hours" (p. 7)?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example a map of ΔJ against B for S1 like your Fig. 4e?
How was each field reached: swept at 50 mK, or field cooled? Does a field-cooled state at 9 to 14 T start in the high-Jc state before any pump?

What are the sample cross-sections and the contact resistances, how much power do the 40 mA reset and the pumps dissipate in the contacts and the sample, and where is the thermometer behind the Supplementary temperature traces?

ΔJ is read at V = 1 µV, and the memory region ends where ΔJ "reaches zero within the resolution of the measurement" (Fig. 4g caption, p. 11). How do the boundaries in Fig. 4e and 4f move for other voltage criteria and other Jex, and what is the ΔJ resolution?

In S2 at 0°, ΔJ starts near 7 T and peaks near 10 T (Fig. 4e), while the low-Jc coexistence region you cite lies at about 15 to 20 T (p. 5). What sets the lower edge of the memory region, and does it move with sample quality the way the upper edge does?
